messages:
Maria (CS): @Akash quick sync on BlueFjord private/VPC onboarding. They asked about KMS key rotation, IAM role mapping for our runner, and how audit logs will be delivered to their SIEM. Also flagged a compliance deadline 2025-09-15 — can infra confirm open items?

Akash (Eng): Got it. Do we have their CloudTrail -> S3 set up? For Splunk pulls we need an S3 prefix + correct KMS policy. Also need the account ID to create the assumeRole.

Maria (CS): Customer pasted confirmation: account_id=123456789012 external_id=bluefjord-cs-2025. They will point Splunk at s3://redwood-audit-bluefjord/. They want 24mo retention and server-side encryption with their CMK. Provided key ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-efgh-1234.

Dave (Infra): OK. I can create the cross-account role and the bucket policy. Quick notes: 1) we need to ensure the CMK key policy allows our service principal (redwood-service@redwood-inference). 2) enable-key-rotation on the CMK if they want automatic rotation. Example KMS policy snippet below.

Dave (Infra): ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowRedwoodService",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::999999999999:role/redwood-service"},
      "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```

Akash (Eng): For rotation: we can use KMS automatic rotation. I will run: `aws kms enable-key-rotation --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-efgh-1234` once Dave confirms policy changes. Also will update the onboarding doc with the command.

Maria (CS): They also asked about cross-account replication vs Splunk pull. Customer says Splunk will pull directly from the bucket, so no replication needed. They want a presigned URL option for immediate ingest in case of emergency.

Dave (Infra): Presigned URLs are fine for ad-hoc wraps. I'll set bucket lifecycle to 730 days and attach a bucket policy that allows their Splunk IAM to GetObject. I'll add server-side encryption with the CMK above. Also adding a note to require MFA for the assumeRole.

Akash (Eng): Can you paste the trust policy you're intending to attach to the cross-account role? I want to validate the sts:AssumeRole conditions (external-id & MFA).

Dave (Infra): Sure — trust policy we plan to use:```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:root"},
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
      "Condition": { "StringEquals": { "sts:ExternalId": "bluefjord-cs-2025" } }
    }
  ]
}
```

Akash (Eng): LGTM. Two small asks: add `aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent` condition for critical actions and make sure the role has `logs:PutObject` permission to write to the S3 audit prefix if needed.

Maria (CS): Great. I'll update the CS ticket with these action items and schedule the handoff call Thu 10am PT. Also flagging renewal risk: customer mentioned compliance milestone — I'll mark as high-touch until 2025-09-15.

deploy-bot: deployment/create-iam-role-bluefjord succeeded at 2025-08-12T15:20:12Z

Dave (Infra): Done: created role, attached policy, added bucket lifecycle. I'll push the policy JSON to the shared folder and ping when the KMS policy is updated.

Akash (Eng): I'll run the enable-key-rotation step once Dave confirms changes. After that I'll publish the short runbook for CS (how to rotate, how to grant Splunk access, how to revoke).

Maria (CS): Thanks all — keeping this open until rotation + bucket policy + role are confirmed. Next update here after Dave confirms KMS changes. :thumbsup:
